commits.subject: feat(notification-gates): add declarative per-option inputs and per-option submission
feat(mobile): accept per-option gate inputs on the mobile bridge
feat(notification-gates): run gate actions from the ACE modals
feat(notification-gates): surface declared and submitted gate input

refactor(gates): one feedback-to-input rule for every surface

metadata.clan_summary:
[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC sase-h7[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Gate input collection and repeatable non-terminal gate actions[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A reviewer can supply typed, validated input to any gate command [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]from every surface, and can run repeatable non-terminal gate [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]actions — starting with `edit_file` — that help them decide without[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]answering the gate. Custom gates that declare required input become[/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]answerable instead of silently stuck, the three incompatible [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]feedback rules collapse into one, and the free-text smuggling that [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]snooze and triage rely on is retired.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]12[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]4[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
[dim]   Path: [#87AFFF][/dim]plans:202608/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]gate_input_collection.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim] Prompt: [#87AFFF][/dim]prompts/202608/gate_input_collection.md[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Bead: [#87AFFF][/dim]sase-h7[/#87AFFF]
[dim]   Page: [#87AFFF][/dim]https://github.com/sase-org/sase--beads/blob/main/pages/sase-h7/[bold #87AFFF][/#87AFFF]README.md[/bold #87AFFF]
[dim]  1 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Diagnosable input failures and non-destructive retry[/bold #D7AFFF]          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]executor-integrity[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]executor-integrity: move gate input-schema validation inside the [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]error-recording path, bound input size and depth, and add a per-attempt [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]execution journal so a partially executed AND branch can be resumed or [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]restarted deliberately instead of silently re-running its completed [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]commands.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  2 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]One feedback-to-input rule for every surface[/bold #D7AFFF]                  [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]feedback-input[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]feedback-input: replace ACE's never-copy, mobile's option-id heuristic, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and Telegram's required-list heuristic with one shared helper that [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]injects the reviewer's note as `input.feedback` whenever the selected [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]option's schema declares a `feedback` property, after auditing every [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]built-in schema.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  3 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Declarative per-option inputs and per-option submission[/bold #D7AFFF]       [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]inputs-core[dim] · [dim][/dim]no dependencies[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]inputs-core: add the closed per-option `inputs:` authoring vocabulary [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]built on `InputArg`/`InputType` (plus a new `enum` type), compile it [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]into the option's `input_schema` at creation, and teach the executor to [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]accept and persist one input value per selected option instead of one [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]shared blob.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  4 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Repeatable non-terminal gate actions[/bold #D7AFFF]                          [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]gate-actions[dim] · [dim][/dim]after executor-integrity[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]gate-actions: generalize `operations` into a rendered vocabulary of [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]repeatable actions that never answer the gate — `edit_file` gains [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]presentation and an origin-file edit target, and a new `run_command` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]kind runs a hashed bundle command whose output is shown to the reviewer.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  5 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Fail closed at creation for unanswerable gates[/bold #D7AFFF]                [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]custom-validation[dim] · [dim][/dim]after inputs-core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]custom-validation: add the missing `kind_validation/custom.py`, reject [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]at creation any option whose effective input schema cannot accept what a[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]client can produce, pin the JSON Schema dialect, and make an omitted [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`input_schema` mean "no input" instead of the permissive empty schema.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  6 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Generic typed input collection in the ACE gate modals[/bold #D7AFFF]         [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]inputs-ace[dim] · [dim][/dim]after inputs-core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]inputs-ace: extract the typed-field form out of `InputCollectionModal` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]into a reusable widget and render each selected option's declared inputs[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]inside `GateBranchControls`, so plan, epic, custom, triage, and snooze [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]gates all collect input with no per-kind code.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  7 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Gate actions in the ACE modals and the plan edit round trip[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]gate-actions-ace[dim] · [dim][/dim]after gate-actions[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]gate-actions-ace: render an Actions section in the shared gate modals, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]run `edit_file` in place without tearing down the modal, point the plan [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and epic edit action at the durable `~/.sase/plans/` file, and block [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]submission while an unaccepted draft exists.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  8 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Mobile wire and Telegram step flow for declared inputs[/bold #D7AFFF]        [bold white on #D75F87] large  [/bold white on #D75F87]
    [#AF87FF]inputs-remote[dim] · [dim][/dim]after feedback-input, inputs-core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]inputs-remote: extend the frozen `mobile_api_v1` gate contract in [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`sase-core` with declared input fields and per-option submitted values, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]update the Rust request struct, routes, and Python bridge, and add an [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]input step flow to the Telegram gate conversation.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  9 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]sase gate answer, act, and show[/bold #D7AFFF]                               [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]gate-cli[dim] · [dim][/dim]after gate-actions, inputs-core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]gate-cli: add headless `answer`, `act`, and `show` subcommands to `sase [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]gate` and build the cross-surface conformance fixture matrix that runs [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]the same input cases through ACE, the mobile bridge, and the CLI.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  10 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Show the input a gate asks for and the input it received[/bold #D7AFFF]     [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]surface-input[dim] · [dim][/dim]after gate-actions, inputs-core[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]surface-input: render declared and submitted input in the gate detail [/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]and executed actions to `sase gate wait --json`.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  11 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Retire free-text smuggling from snooze, triage, and launch[/bold #D7AFFF]   [bold black on #FFD75F] medium [/bold black on #FFD75F]
    [#AF87FF]retire-smuggling[dim] · [dim][/dim]after feedback-input, inputs-ace, inputs-remote[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]retire-smuggling: express snooze durations as declared `enum`/`line` [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]inputs, delete the two `validate_selection` re-parsing special cases, [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]and drop the launch gate's fake `feedback` option id now that feedback [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]is an ordinary input field.[/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF][/#D7D7AF]
[dim]  12 [bold #AF87FF][/dim]◆ [bold #D7AFFF][/bold #AF87FF]Document the input and action contracts[/bold #D7AFFF]                      [bold black on #87D7FF] small  [/bold black on #87D7FF]
    [#AF87FF]docs[dim] · [dim][/dim]after custom-validation, gate-actions-ace, gate-cli, [/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#AF87FF][dim]retire-smuggling, surface-input[/#AF87FF][/dim]
    [#D7D7AF]docs: add gate-input and gate-action sections to [/#D7D7AF]
    [#D7D7AF]`docs/notifications.md`, rewrite the `/sase_gate` skill's input guidance[/#D7D7AF]

    [#D7D7AF]type, and regenerate the deployed skills.[/#D7D7AF]
